left.title: Obama Speaks Out On Trump Ending Dreamer Protections
left.body: Former President Barack Obama said Tuesday that President Donald Trump’s decision to dismantle the program protecting young undocumented immigrants was “contrary to our spirit, and to common sense.”
left.roundup: Former president Barack Obama on Tuesday criticized President Trump's decision to end the immigration program designed to protect undocumented immigrants who were brought to the U.S. as children.

right.title: Obama Rips Trump As ‘Cruel’ For Rolling Back DACA Amnesty Program
right.body: Former President Obama lashed out at President Trump for ending the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) amnesty program, which was thought to be on shaky legal ground.
